product_metadata.title: Ontel Arctic Air Personal Space Cooler Replacement Filter Authentic OEM, Black, 1 Count (Pack of 1) (AAF-MO6)
features: ARCTIC AIR CONDITIONER FILTER: Compatible with the Arctic Air Ultra Evaporative Air Cooler. Keep your ac cooler clean and longer-lasting with this air filter replacement filter made of sponge material to trap dust & other air impurities.

REPLACEMENT AIR FILTER: True Shield replacement filter ensures durability while keeping your personal space cool. Soak in water and place in freezer for ultra-cold experience. BPA-free filter is good with hard water.
FILTER FOR AC: The replacement humidifier filter for the tabletop air purifier cooler takes hot & dry air to make it cool, moist & comfortable. Perfect for allergies! Replace every 3-6 months.

AS SEEN ON TV: Ontel Products are composed of many individual brands each serving customers in different ways. Try a variety of products from some of our brands like Pillow Pets, Miracle Socks, Iron Gym, Miracle Bamboo Cushion, Dream Tents, & more.

INNOVATIVE WITH ONTEL: Since 1994, we’ve been developing, marketing, & distributing some of the most innovative consumer products on the market. From toys, to fitness equipment & household items, we love bringing new ideas into the world.
